pages.title: Colossus of the forest
pages.text: A colossal tree about a hundred blocks tall, guarded by a coven of $(thing)ten mavkas$().$(br2)Small outbuildings cling to its branches, and a house with valuable treasures stands at the very top.

pages.title: Treasure at the top
pages.text: In the house at the top a $(item)Mavka Flower$() grows in a pot. Break the pot and the flower drops as an item.

pages.title: A hindering force
pages.text: Near this tree I cannot remain in $(thing)Spirit Form$(). Perhaps it gives off a force that disturbs my nature.$(br2)Come prepared: ten mavkas with poisonous touches are a serious foe.
